HYJ01SPM0U_C600.title: Pasta Plate
HYJ01SPM0U_C600.description: Christian Dior was particularly fond of lily of the valley, a symbol of the fine weather heralding the arrival of spring and the haute couture season. He sewed a dried sprig into the hem of each dress as a sign of good luck. An emblem of renewal, the printed and embroidered lily of the valley flourishes on House creations, its evocative name and white color adorning a multitude of silhouettes, like the Bonheur wedding dress. A tribute to Mr. Dior's love, the Lily of the Valley collection by Cordelia de Castellane is enhanced by new pieces dedicated to tableware. The delicate lily of the valley accents a range of creations, including two decorative porcelain objects, a pasta plate, cereal bowl, three-tiered cake stand, oval platter and deep round platter. The line is an ode to good fortune and a promise of sophisticated elegance.

HYJ01RSM0U_C700.title: Napkin Ring
HYJ01RSM0U_C700.description: Having inherited a passion for flowers from my mother, I especially enjoyed the company of plants and gardeners, Christian Dior confided in his memoirs. Adorned with designs of lily of the valley, the couturier's lucky charm, the Lily of the Valley tableware line is enhanced by new wicker pieces — like placemats, baskets, frames and boxes — decorated with sprigs of the flower.

HYO03MUS0L_C970.title: Embroidered Placemat and Napkin Set
HYO03MUS0L_C970.description: Dior Maison unveils new designs for the Lily of the Valley collection with a subtle homage to the founding couturier's lucky flower. Inspired by the eponymous dress created by Mr. Dior for the Spring-Summer 1957 Haute Couture Fashion Show, delicate, embossed bell-shaped flowers accent a set of sophisticated creations, including glasses, candles and even table linens. Continuing this pastoral poetry, a selection of glassware pieces is enhanced by four-leaf clovers or engraved with lilies of the valley, in a bucolic ode to Christian Dior's passion for superstition. As a final surprise, elegant palm tree and ladybug ceramic candle holders, available in green and white, complete this exceptional selection. The refined collection suggests a springtime getaway and sunny days to come. *These objects of desire were developed in collaboration with the Jean Roger workshop.

100% linen

HYI04GPP1U_C000.title: Water Bottle
HYI04GPP1U_C000.description: Dior Maison showcases the Plan de Paris line in celebration of the streets of Paris: from Faubourg-Saint-Honoré where Mr. Dior glimpsed his lucky star, to 30 Avenue Montaigne, the iconic House address and flagship of savoir-faire and excellence. Echoing Maria Grazia Chiuri's Dior Spring-Summer 2023 ready-to-wear collection inspiration, a graphically shaded map of Paris adorns exceptional creations like an elegant water bottle, embroidered pillows and placemats. Diving deeper into the Parisian tribute, the bewitching motif — available on a white or black background — comes to life on a porcelain case of refined candles, as well as on a set of two notebooks. An invitation to stroll through the City of Light and admire its unique magic that has inspired the House since its founding in 1946.
